explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` and `next_token()` to walk the fragment in document order, appending decoded `#text` tokens plus the opener text for `TITLE` and `TEXTAREA`, which the documented HTML Processor says carry their contents on the element token itself. Truncation is done by Unicode code points with `mb_strlen`/`mb_substr` when available, with a UTF-8 regex fallback.
